index.heading: Tools for StSF
index.bookmarklets: Small tools that you save as bookmarks and use with the member system.
bookmarklets.lead: Save a tool in the bookmarks bar and run it on the page where it is needed.
bookmarklets.status: Drag the button to the bookmarks bar, or copy the code.
bookmarklets.clicked: Drag the button to the bookmarks bar instead of clicking it, or copy the code.
bookmarklets.copy_done: The code is copied. Paste it as the address of a new bookmark.
bookmarklets.copy_failed: Could not copy automatically. The code is selected; copy it with Ctrl+C or ⌘+C.
bookmarklets.install_drag: Drag the button to the bookmarks bar.
bookmarklets.install_copy: Or click Copy the code, create a new bookmark and paste the code as its address.
bookmarklets.install_locale: The bookmark speaks English. Switch language before installing it to get it in Swedish.
index.more_tools_lead: Sign in to see the tools you have access to.
access.title: Access
access.lead: Enter the Google groups whose members may use each tool, separated by commas. Members of nested groups are included. Changes apply from each user's next sign-in; users already signed in are unaffected.
access.not_mounted: This tool is not installed in the portal yet.
access.saved: Access saved. It applies from each user's next sign-in.
access.invalid: Correct the marked fields. Nothing was saved.
